exact_statement: Let a:{-1,1}^k->{-1,0,1}, b=1-a^2, h:{-1,1}^n->{-1,1} on disjoint uniform cubes, sigma in {-1,1}. Supply normalized finite-CE R with R(empty)=(Eh)^2 and the COMPLETE coherent reference Q(U,empty)=(ahat(U)+sigma*Eh*bhat(U))^2, Q(U,T)=bhat(U)^2 R(T) for nonempty T. At a physical seed query j write u_T=hhat(T), v_T=hhat(T+j), m=Eh, d=v_empty, beta=sum bhat^2, C=sum ahat^2 bhat^2, D=sum ahat bhat^3, E4=sum bhat^4, Gamma=C-D^2/E4>=0 (zero if E4=0). Choose ANY partition W_l of remaining NONEMPTY seed frequencies before the physical outcome; c_l=sum_{T in W_l}u_T v_T and x=Gamma*d^2+E4*sum_l c_l^2. Calibrate BOTH inherited full child marginals on each vacuum atom and each controller-frequency/nonempty-bin block to its ACTUAL child mass, retaining current conditional profile within each bin. This gives coherent Rcal_tau with actual vacuum and Rcal_tau(T)=P_h_tau(W_l)*Rbar(T)/Rbar(W_l). At positive t_tau*x, t_tau=beta*Var(h_tau), mix its CURRENT conditional nonempty profile with ANY prescribed normalized target at epsilon_tau=x/(t_tau+x); otherwise make no mixture. The complete transaction increment B_j(G)+average CE(P_child,Qnew_child)-CE(P_G,Q) is <=-D_occ-x/ln2<=0 in bits. Refund>=2x/ln2 and mixture liability<=x/ln2. Every finite adaptive coherent continuation telescopes using CURRENT references, SAME initial supplied rate/account and all old debits/full siblings. Two sign bins Wplus={nonempty T:u_T v_T>=0}, Wminus={nonempty T:u_T v_T<0} maximize sum c_l^2 over partitions. If d=0 and beta>0, x=(E4/2)*(sum_nonempty |u_T v_T|)^2, positive EXACTLY when the two child squared spectra differ. For fixed A079 controller beta=3/8,E4=21/512,Gamma=9/3584 and actual balanced seed h=x3 times the two-bit point-defect, query1 has d=0,x=21/4096 and both nonconstant children admit epsilon=7/519. This does not fund arbitrary positive-strength changes on zero-energy isospectral queries or supply an influence-priced arbitrary-seed initial reference. Full FEI remains OPEN.
